smartFlows are 1h per-wallet Smart Inflow card rows from the signed-in GMGN endpoint smartmoney_cards/cards/sol/1h (Monitor > Smart, 1h, https://gmgn.ai/monitor?chain=sol&tab=smartdegen), not the left-rail Smart Degen feed or Smart Net Inflow aggregates. The payload had 100 token cards and included every wallet row on each card, not only the rows visible in the virtualized board. usd is the signed 1h net inflow the API returned (net_inflow); some Sell All/Sell Partial rows are still positive (and a few First Buy/Buy More rows negative) because that column is 1h net, not the last fill. Action labels First Buy / Buy More / Sell All / Sell Partial were taken from the API side + is_open_or_close fields (buy+1, buy+0, sell+1, sell+0). The inflow API used is the 100-card payload from the same signed-in session (HAR exported via DevTools Network with content after Preserve log and Disable cache; the Network log could not be cleared this run so the HAR also contains earlier same-session requests; extract_har.py selected the 100-card smartmoney_cards/cards/sol/1h body and the trending_multichain body). Trending screenshots were taken at ~10:15 AM ET; inflow screenshots at ~10:16 AM ET. 0 wallet rows were skipped for a missing action, address, or net inflow.
